buttons.description: Buttons to act on. Button names: A, B, X, Y, L, R, ZL, ZR, PLUS, MINUS, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, LSTICK, RSTICK, HOME, CAPTURE.

screenshot.description: If true, the result also includes a screenshot taken after the input, saving a separate screenshot call.

screenshotDelayMs.description: Delay before that screenshot in ms (lets the UI settle). Default 250.

screenshotScale.description: Scale of that screenshot: 0.5 gives 640x360, a quarter of the image cost. Default 1.

tools.name: tap_buttons
tools.description: Press and release controller buttons (synchronous). A virtual Pro Controller is attached automatically.

durationMs.description: How long to hold before releasing, in ms. Default 100, max 10000.

tools.name: tap_sequence
tools.description: Perform a sequence of button taps in one call, e.g. to navigate menus. Each step presses its buttons, holds, releases, then waits before the next step.

delayAfterMs.description: Pause after release in ms. Default 150.

tools.name: hold_buttons
tools.description: Press buttons and keep them held until release_buttons or clear_input.

tools.name: set_stick
tools.description: Set an analog stick position. x/y range -1.0..1.0 (y=1.0 is up). With durationMs the stick recenters afterwards; without it the position persists until changed or clear_input.

tools.name: tap_screen
tools.description: Tap the touch screen at a pixel coordinate. Coordinates are in the same 1280x720 space as the screenshot tool, so you can read them straight off the image: x 0-1279 left to right, y 0-719 top to bottom. Only reaches the console in handheld mode (docked, the panel is off).

durationMs.description: How long the finger stays down. Default 100, min 32, max 10000. Raise it for a long press.

tools.name: swipe_screen
tools.description: Drag a finger across the touch screen, e.g. to scroll a list or flick a page. Same 1280x720 coordinate space as the screenshot tool. The gesture is interpolated over durationMs, which is what makes scrolling register - a fast swipe flicks, a slow one drags.

durationMs.description: Time from start to end. Default 300, max 10000.

tools.name: clear_input
tools.description: Release all held buttons and recenter both sticks.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text on a virtual USB keyboard, e.g. into the system software keyboard once a text field has opened it, instead of picking letters with the D-pad. Keys are chosen for the console's own keyboard layout (it follows the system language); English (US), English (UK) and French are supported, including accented letters those layouts can type (French: é è à ç ù ê ë...). \n is Enter, \t Tab, \b Backspace. Text the layout cannot type is rejected before anything is typed. Software that ignores USB keyboards does not see it.

text.description: Text to type (UTF-8), at most 256 bytes.

keyMs.description: How long each key is held, and the gap after it, in ms. Default 40.
